derivation: or תֹּגַרְמָה; probably of foreign derivation;
def: Togarmah, a son of Gomer and his posterity

occurrences.text: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
They of the house of Togarmah traded in thy fairs with horses and horsemen and mules.
Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands: and many people with thee.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
